index.title: Turning Comparisons into a Reward Model
index.prompt: Fit a Bradley-Terry reward model to 2,897 pairwise preferences, measure how well it recovers the latent rewards, and confirm the likelihood cannot identify the absolute level.
index.answer: Auto-graded inside the notebook. Likelihood, correlation, and rank agreement must match to 1e-5, with the likelihood exactly invariant to shifting every reward.
